newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Feb 2.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Feb 2.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi Arabia's electricity firms to pay 520 million riyals to shareholders.
- Saudi Arabian Airlines resumes flights to Beirut.
- Saudi Investment Bank posts a 124.6 million riyal net profit in 1996.
- Dubai Commercial Bank posts 144 million dirhams in net profit in 1996.
- Official opening of Gulf Ferroalloys Company (Sabayek) in the Saudi industrial city of Jubail will take place on February 13.
- International Monetary Fund to decide on Sudan's membership on Monday.
